Definition: to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia
BiblicalUsage: 1) to act as a priest, minister in a priest's office; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to minister as a priest, serve as a priest; 1a2) to be or become a priest; 1a3) to play the priest
